system_description.narrative_title: Tech & Minerals Supply-Chain Clash: US–China Economic-Security Race
system_description.narrative_summary: The single dominant narrative is a global reconfiguration of technology and critical‑minerals supply chains driven by an intensifying US–China economic‑security rivalry. China is reporting strong export growth and using trade levers while the US responds with tariffs, export controls, subsidies and financing to onshore capacity and secure mineral supplies. Corporates and resource states are reacting with large capex plans, export bans and strategic partnerships, producing cascading effects across chips, solar, batteries and mining.
system_description.scope: Flows of advanced technology goods, critical minerals, capital and policy between China, the United States, resource-exporting countries and multinational firms; included are concrete actors (states, chipmakers, miners, banks, exporters), processes (tariffs, export controls, subsidies, investment, export bans), market signals (trade balances, prices, investor actions) and near-term catalysts (tariff actions, investments, export orders).
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economy and strategic competition among major powers
adjacent_subsystems: Global financial markets and investor sentiment
Regional geopolitics and resource diplomacy (Africa, Southeast Asia)
Technology standards, cybersecurity and export-control regimes

variables.name: Cross-border advanced tech and mineral trade flows
variables.description: The volume and value rate of advanced technology goods and critical minerals moving across borders between economic regions.

variables.name: Export control & restriction intensity
variables.description: The strictness, frequency and administrative burden of export controls, licensing and restrictions applied to sensitive technologies and components.

variables.name: Tariff and import tax level
variables.description: The average level of tariffs and ad valorem trade taxes applied to targeted technology products and critical-mineral inputs.

variables.name: Subsidies and strategic financing level
variables.description: The magnitude and prevalence of public subsidies, concessional loans and targeted financing aimed at building domestic production and processing capacity.

variables.name: Domestic manufacturing capacity
variables.description: Installed production capacity for advanced technologies, components and related manufacturing within a given economic area.

variables.name: Available critical minerals stock
variables.description: Accessible inventories, reserves and processed stocks of critical minerals available for industrial use.

variables.name: Mineral extraction and production rate
variables.description: The pace at which critical minerals are mined, processed and introduced into the upstream supply chain.

variables.name: Corporate capital expenditure rate
variables.description: The flow rate of private-sector investment spending directed toward mining, processing, and technology production assets.

variables.name: Supplier and sourcing diversification
variables.description: The degree to which supply chains source inputs from multiple independent suppliers, technologies and geographic regions.

variables.name: Export bans and outbound restriction prevalence
variables.description: The frequency, scope and scope-expansiveness of bans and outbound restrictions on raw or processed minerals and components.

variables.name: Cross-border technology transfer rate
variables.description: The speed and volume of technology, know‑how and embedded IP flows across borders via licensing, partnerships and other channels.

variables.name: Aggregate trade balance in tech/minerals
variables.description: Net exports minus imports of advanced technologies and critical minerals aggregated across the global system or region of study.

variables.name: Market prices of critical inputs
variables.description: Prevailing spot and contract prices for polysilicon, cobalt, tungsten, semiconductor wafers and other critical inputs.

variables.name: Availability of risk capital and financing
variables.description: The liquidity, cost and willingness of public and private capital markets to provide funding for mining and technology production projects.

variables.name: Research & development intensity
variables.description: R&D expenditure relative to industry output or revenue in advanced technology sectors, indicating innovation throughput.

variables.name: Supply chain resilience and redundancy
variables.description: The system's capacity to absorb, reroute and recover from disruptions to production, logistics and input availability.

catalysts.title: US 15% polysilicon tariff implementation
catalysts.description: Implementation of the announced 15% tariff and minimum prices on polysilicon/solar components, raising trade barriers and prices for solar supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "Trump to Impose 15% Tariff, Set Minimum Prices on Solar Panels and Components"; "Trump unveils trade actions to protect key solar and semiconductor material".

catalysts.title: US export bans on tungsten, metal waste and used critical minerals
catalysts.description: Ongoing U.S. restrictions and bans on outbound shipments of tungsten, battery waste and other materials to preserve domestic feedstocks and security supplies.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "US bans exports of various used critical minerals"; "Trump admin blocks tungsten, battery waste exports to boost US minerals supply".

catalysts.title: DRC bans copper and cobalt concentrates exports
catalysts.description: Democratic Republic of Congo enforcement of a ban on concentrates exports, disrupting upstream flows and pressuring global cobalt/copper availability.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "EXCLUSIVE: Congo bans copper and cobalt concentrates exports, official order says" (Reuters).

catalysts.title: US $2–3B minerals and battery subsidy package
catalysts.description: Planned federal awards and investments into battery, materials and minerals projects to build domestic processing and defense-oriented supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "Trump Administration to Award $2 Billion to Battery, Materials Companies"; "Trump administration to invest $3 billion into minerals projects".

catalysts.title: Apple testing Chinese CXMT memory chips
catalysts.description: Apple's testing and possible qualification of CXMT memory chips may accelerate adoption of Chinese memory suppliers and shift sourcing dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "Apple tests China's CXMT memory chips for iPhones and MacBooks"; "Apple Tests Chinese Memory Chips as Supply Squeeze Bites".

catalysts.title: SK Hynix $38bn memory plant expansion
catalysts.description: Massive SK Hynix capital program to build new memory fabs in South Korea, expanding onshore production capacity for memory chips.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants"; board approves $38 bln investments headlines.

catalysts.title: India polysilicon incentives rollout
catalysts.description: Indian policy to provide incentives for polysilicon production aimed at reducing reliance on China and developing local solar input capacity.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "India plans polysilicon incentives to reduce reliance on China" (headline).

catalysts.title: Xi visit and truce-testing diplomacy
catalysts.description: Upcoming Xi visit (weeks away per reporting) that could test and possibly ease trade-security tensions between China and the U.S.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "Beijing flips the script on the U.S. tech war — and tests the truce weeks before Xi's visit".

catalysts.title: DRC probe into uranium-contaminated cobalt exports
catalysts.description: Investigation into contamination could prompt tighter controls, testing, or buyer restrictions on DRC cobalt supplies in coming months.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "DR Congo launches probe into uranium-contaminated cobalt exports" suggesting regulatory/market responses.

catalysts.title: US administration to host mining CEOs
catalysts.description: Planned White House engagement with mining CEOs to align industry with defense/minerals policy and potentially accelerate public-private projects.
catalysts.rationale: Driven by: "Trump to host mining CEOs as administration seeks minerals for defense supply chains" (headline).
